§6Engine Lubricant§f

§aKeep your machines oiled and your production chains moving.§f

Engine Lubricant is a specialized fluid from §bHeavy Oil§f or §bIndustrial Oil§f. Required for various advanced machine recipes.

§6Production§f:
§b• Fractioning Tower§f: §e100mB§f Industrial Oil → §e60mB§f Heating Oil + §e40mB§f Engine Lubricant.
§b• Chemical Plant§f: §e2,000mB§f Heavy Oil → §e1,000mB§f Engine Lubricant (requires §bBlueprint: Lubricant from Heavy Oil§f).

§6Uses§f:
§b• Advanced Machinery§f: Crafting component for various HBM machines.
§b• Paraffin Wax§f: Solidify engine lubricant in the §bIndustrial Solidification Machine§f for §bParaffin Wax§f, which combines with §bChlorine Gas§f for §bChlorinated Petroleum Wax§f.

§ePS:§f The §bChemical Plant§f route gives a §e50%§f conversion (§e2,000mB§f → §e1,000mB§f). The §bFractioning Tower§f route produces lubricant as a co-product alongside Heating Oil, best when you are already fractioning Industrial Oil.
